narrative.overview: The ERP is a shop counter kept in order: everything the staff need is within reach, nothing shouts, and the one thing that must be seen is lit in lime. A pale grey canvas holds white, borderless, generously rounded cards; the side menu is a column of soft pills; figures sit large and calm in pastel tiles. The feel is soft and sure: round corners, big touch targets, a dark primary button that says "this is the action". It is built for a phone in one hand at the counter as much as for a long desk session, in Bangla first.
keyCharacteristics: Pale grey canvas, white borderless cards, 20px corners.
Lime marks "you are here / this is on" and nothing else.
Dark primary button in light mode; lime primary button in dark mode.
Pastel KPI tiles that cycle peach, lavender, mint, lemon, sky.
Flat tables with a muted head and hairline rows.
Pills everywhere a choice is made (tabs, chips, segments, the business switch).

rules.name: The One Lime Rule
rules.body: Lime means "selected" or "on". It is never decoration, never a background for a whole section, and its text is always Ink.

rules.name: The Dark-Text-on-Light-Fill Rule
rules.body: Any fill lighter than mid-grey (lime, pastel, soft status) carries Ink text. In dark mode the accent fill is lime, so white text on it is a bug (fixed 29 Oct 2026, clean-contrast-1).

rules.name: The Bangla Size Rule
rules.body: Bangla text never goes below the body size for anything a person must read; Bangla glyphs need the room. Shrink by trimming words, not by shrinking type.

rules.name: The Tone-Not-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Depth comes from canvas grey against card white. A card never gets a border and never gets a heavy shadow at rest.

dos: Do use Lime only for the selected / on state, always with Ink (#17181C) text.
Do keep cards white, borderless, 20px round, on the grey canvas.
Do put a new ability on the first screen as a visible button with a verb-first label.
Do keep Bangla at body size or larger and check every screen at 375px with no sideways scroll.
Do check light and dark: any light fill carries Ink text.
donts: Don't put white text on lime, pastel or soft status fills.
Don't add borders or heavy shadows to cards at rest.
Don't use violet for a new selected state; the selected state is lime.
Don't put grey hint text beside form labels; use a "?" help button.
Don't hard-code Costareen's name, logo or colours into a screen; the business's own branding leads.
Don't let anything appear and then vanish on reload.
